<!doctype html>
<html lang="pt-BR">
  <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
    <title>Bralyx — Copiloto de PCP</title>
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2"></script>
    <script src="https://unpkg.com/lucide@latest"></script>
    <style>
      :root {
        /* Paleta Bralyx (carvão industrial + verde-limão da marca) */
        --bg: #f3f5ef;
        --panel: #ffffff;
        --card: #ffffff;
        --line: #e6e9df;
        --txt: #1d2128;
        --muted: #6b7280;
        --pri: #6f9a23;
        --pri2: #54761a;
        --pri-soft: #eef5da;
        --accent: #a7c84b;
        --brand1: #242a32;
        --brand2: #14181d;
        --ok: #16a34a;
        --okbg: #e8f7ee;
        --no: #dc2626;
        --nobg: #fdeaea;
        --warn: #d97706;
        --warnbg: #fff4e3;
        --chip: #eef1ea;
        --shadow:
          0 1px 2px rgba(20, 24, 29, 0.05), 0 4px 16px rgba(20, 24, 29, 0.07);
        --sidebar-width: 256px;
      }
      * {
        box-sizing: border-box;
      }
      body {
        margin: 0;
        font-family: system-ui, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Arial, sans-serif;
        background: var(--bg);
        color: var(--txt);
        font-size: 14px;
      }
      a {
        color: var(--pri2);
      }
      button {
        font-family: inherit;
        cursor: pointer;
        border: none;
        border-radius: 9px;
        padding: 8px 14px;
        font-weight: 600;
        transition:
          background 0.15s,
          color 0.15s,
          box-shadow 0.15s,
          transform 0.08s,
          filter 0.15s;
      }
      button:active {
        transform: translateY(1px);
      }
      button:disabled {
        opacity: 0.5;
        cursor: not-allowed;
        filter: grayscale(0.2);
        box-shadow: none;
      }
      button:disabled:active {
        transform: none;
      }
      .btn-pri {
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--pri), var(--pri2));
        color: #fff;
        box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(84, 118, 26, 0.35);
      }
      .btn-pri:hover {
        filter: brightness(1.06);
        box-shadow: 0 3px 10px rgba(84, 118, 26, 0.32);
      }
      .btn-ok {
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1fb955, var(--ok));
        color: #fff;
      }
      .btn-ok:hover {
        filter: brightness(1.05);
      }
      .btn-no {
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ef4444, var(--no));
        color: #fff;
      }
      .btn-no:hover {
        filter: brightness(1.05);
      }
      .btn-ghost {
        background: #fff;
        color: var(--txt);
        border: 1px solid var(--line);
      }
      .btn-ghost:hover {
        background: var(--pri-soft);
        color: var(--pri2);
        border-color: var(--pri);
      }
      .btn-sm {
        padding: 5px 10px;
        font-size: 12.5px;
        border-radius: 8px;
      }
      input,
      select,
      textarea {
        font-family: inherit;
        font-size: 14px;
        padding: 9px 11px;
        border: 1px solid var(--line);
        border-radius: 9px;
        background: #fff;
        color: var(--txt);
        width: 100%;
      }
      input:focus,
      select:focus,
      textarea:focus {
        outline: none;
        border-color: var(--pri);
        box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--pri-soft);
      }
      label {
        font-size: 12.5px;
        font-weight: 600;
        color: var(--muted);
        display: block;
        margin-bottom: 5px;
      }
      .hidden {
        display: none !important;
      }
      .muted {
        color: var(--muted);
      }
      .row {
        display: flex;
        gap: 10px;
        align-items: center;
      }
      .wrap {
        flex-wrap: wrap;
      }
      .grow {
        flex: 1;
      }

      /* ===== Login ===== */
      #login {
        position: fixed;
        inset: 0;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        background:
          radial-gradient(
            1200px 600px at 72% -10%,
            rgba(167, 200, 75, 0.18),
            transparent
          ),
          linear-gradient(135deg, #14181d, #242a32);
      }
      .login-card {
        width: 380px;
        max-width: 92vw;
        background: #fff;
        border-radius: 18px;
        padding: 34px 30px;
        box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(8, 12, 18, 0.45);
      }
      .brand-mark {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: flex-start;
        gap: 11px;
      }
      .brand-mark .logo-badge {
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--brand1), var(--brand2));
        padding: 14px 22px;
        border-radius: 14px;
        box-shadow: 0 8px 22px rgba(20, 24, 29, 0.22);
      }
      .brand-mark .logo-badge img {
        display: block;
        height: 30px;
        width: auto;
      }
      .brand-mark small {
        display: block;
        font-size: 11px;
        font-weight: 700;
        letter-spacing: 2px;
        color: var(--muted);
      }
      .login-card h1 {
        font-size: 16px;
        margin: 18px 0 4px;
      }
      .login-card p.sub {
        margin: 0 0 18px;
        color: var(--muted);
        font-size: 13px;
      }
      .login-card .field {
        margin-bottom: 13px;
      }
      #loginErr {
        color: var(--no);
        font-size: 13px;
        min-height: 18px;
        margin-top: 8px;
      }

      /* ===== Shell ===== */
      #app {
        display: none;
        min-height: 100vh;
      }
      .sidebar {
        position: fixed;
        top: 0;
        left: 0;
        bottom: 0;
        width: var(--sidebar-width);
        background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--brand1), var(--brand2));
        color: #eaf1fc;
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        padding: 18px 14px;
        z-index: 20;
      }
      .sidebar .logo {
        padding: 6px 6px 2px;
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 7px;
      }
      .sidebar .logo .logo-img {
        display: block;
        height: 28px;
        width: auto;
        align-self: flex-start;
      }
      .sidebar .logo small {
        display: block;
        font-size: 10.5px;
        font-weight: 700;
        letter-spacing: 1.5px;
        color: #a7b29c;
        padding-left: 2px;
      }
      .nav {
        margin-top: 18px;
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 3px;
        flex: 1 1 auto;
        overflow-y: auto;
        min-height: 0;
        padding-right: 2px;
      }
      .nav::-webkit-scrollbar {
        width: 6px;
      }
      .nav::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18);
        border-radius: 6px;
      }
      .nav::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
        background: transparent;
      }
      .nav a {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 11px;
        padding: 10px 12px;
        border-radius: 10px;
        color: #d7ddcf;
        text-decoration: none;
        font-weight: 600;
        font-size: 13.5px;
        cursor: pointer;
        position: relative;
        transition:
          background 0.14s,
          color 0.14s;
      }
      .nav a:hover {
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
        color: #fff;
      }
      .nav a.active {
        background: var(--accent);
        color: #1d2128;
        box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.22);
      }
      .nav a.active::before {
        content: "";
        position: absolute;
        left: -14px;
        top: 8px;
        bottom: 8px;
        width: 4px;
        border-radius: 0 4px 4px 0;
        background: var(--accent);
      }
      .nav a svg {
        width: 18px;
        height: 18px;
        flex: 0 0 auto;
      }
      .nav .sep {
        font-size: 10.5px;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        letter-spacing: 1px;
        color: #9aa890;
        padding: 14px 12px 4px;
      }
      .sidebar .foot {
        flex: 0 0 auto;
        margin-top: 10px;
        padding-top: 12px;
        border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
      }
      .side-user {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 10px;
        padding: 8px 8px;
        border-radius: 10px;
      }
      .side-user .sa {
        width: 34px;
        height: 34px;
        flex: 0 0 auto;
        border-radius: 50%;
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16);
        color: #fff;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        font-weight: 700;
        font-size: 14px;
      }
      .side-user .si {
        min-width: 0;
        line-height: 1.3;
      }
      .side-user .si b {
        display: block;
        font-size: 12.5px;
        color: #fff;
        font-weight: 700;
        white-space: nowrap;
        overflow: hidden;
        text-overflow: ellipsis;
      }
      .side-user .si span {
        display: block;
        font-size: 11px;
        color: #aab59f;
        white-space: nowrap;
        overflow: hidden;
        text-overflow: ellipsis;
      }

      /* hambúrguer (mobile) + backdrop */
      .menu-toggle {
        display: none;
        background: #fff;
        color: var(--pri2);
        border: 1px solid var(--line);
        width: 38px;
        height: 38px;
        padding: 0;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        border-radius: 10px;
      }
      .menu-toggle svg {
        width: 20px;
        height: 20px;
      }
      #sbBackdrop {
        display: none;
        position: fixed;
        inset: 0;
        background: rgba(8, 22, 46, 0.45);
        z-index: 19;
      }
      #sbBackdrop.show {
        display: block;
      }

      .main {
        margin-left: var(--sidebar-width);
        padding: 0 0 60px;
      }
      .topbar {
        position: sticky;
        top: 0;
        z-index: 10;
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.86);
        backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
        border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
        padding: 12px 26px;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 14px;
      }
      .topbar h2 {
        font-size: 17px;
        margin: 0;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 9px;
      }
      .topbar h2 .vt-ico {
        width: 30px;
        height: 30px;
        flex: 0 0 auto;
        border-radius: 9px;
        background: var(--pri-soft);
        color: var(--pri2);
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
      }
      .topbar h2 .vt-ico svg {
        width: 17px;
        height: 17px;
      }
      .topbar .who {
        margin-left: auto;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 12px;
        font-size: 13px;
      }
      .avatar {
        width: 34px;
        height: 34px;
        border-radius: 50%;
        background: var(--pri-soft);
        color: var(--pri2);
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        font-weight: 700;
      }
      .content {
        padding: 22px 26px;
      }

      /* ===== Responsivo (sidebar off-canvas no mobile) ===== */
      @media (max-width: 900px) {
        .menu-toggle {
          display: inline-flex;
        }
        .sidebar {
          transform: translateX(-100%);
          transition: transform 0.22s ease;
          box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(8, 22, 46, 0.4);
        }
        .sidebar.open {
          transform: none;
        }
        .main {
          margin-left: 0;
        }
        .topbar {
          padding: 10px 14px;
        }
        .topbar h2 {
          font-size: 16px;
        }
        .topbar .who .muted {
          display: none;
        }
        .content {
          padding: 16px 14px;
        }
      }

      /* ===== Cards / KPIs ===== */
      .kpis {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(150px, 1fr));
        gap: 14px;
        margin-bottom: 20px;
      }
      .kpi {
        position: relative;
        background: var(--card);
        border: 1px solid var(--line);
        border-radius: 14px;
        padding: 15px 16px 15px 18px;
        box-shadow: var(--shadow);
        overflow: hidden;
      }
      .kpi::before {
        content: "";
        position: absolute;
        left: 0;
        top: 0;
        bottom: 0;
        width: 4px;
        background: var(--pri2);
        opacity: 0.55;
      }
      .kpi .v {
        font-size: 26px;
        font-weight: 800;
      }
      .kpi .l {
        font-size: 12px;
        color: var(--muted);
        margin-top: 2px;
      }
      .kpi.alto .v {
        color: var(--no);
      }
      .kpi.alto::before {
        background: var(--no);
      }
      .kpi.medio .v {
        color: var(--warn);
      }
      .kpi.medio::before {
        background: var(--warn);
      }
      .kpi.baixo .v {
        color: var(--ok);
      }
      .kpi.baixo::before {
        background: var(--ok);
      }
      .kpi.info .v {
        color: var(--pri2);
      }
      .kpi.info::before {
        background: var(--pri2);
      }

      /* ===== Banner de introdução (ajuda por página) ===== */
      .page-intro {
        display: flex;
        gap: 12px;
        align-items: flex-start;
        background: linear-gradient(180deg, #fbfcf8, #f4f8ea);
        border: 1px solid var(--line);
        border-left: 3px solid var(--pri);
        border-radius: 12px;
        padding: 12px 15px;
        margin-bottom: 18px;
      }
      .page-intro .pi-ico {
        width: 36px;
        height: 36px;
        flex: 0 0 auto;
        border-radius: 10px;
        background: var(--pri-soft);
        color: var(--pri2);
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
      }
      .page-intro .pi-ico svg {
        width: 19px;
        height: 19px;
      }
      .page-intro .pi-txt {
        font-size: 13px;
        line-height: 1.5;
        color: #45504a;
        padding-top: 1px;
      }
      .page-intro .pi-txt b {
        color: var(--txt);
      }

      .card {
        background: var(--card);
        border: 1px solid var(--line);
        border-radius: 14px;
        box-shadow: var(--shadow);
        overflow: hidden;
      }
      .card .head {
        padding: 14px 18px;
        border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 12px;
      }
      .card .head h3 {
        margin: 0;
        font-size: 15px;
      }
      .card .body {
        padding: 16px 18px;
      }

      .toolbar {
        display: flex;
        gap: 10px;
        align-items: center;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        margin-bottom: 16px;
      }
      .toolbar .grow {
        flex: 1;
        min-width: 180px;
      }

      /* ===== Table ===== */
      table {
        width: 100%;
        border-collapse: collapse;
        font-size: 13px;
      }
      th,
      td {
        text-align: left;
        padding: 10px 12px;
        border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
        vertical-align: middle;
      }
      th {
        font-size: 11.5px;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        letter-spacing: 0.4px;
        color: var(--muted);
        background: #fafbf6;
        position: sticky;
        top: 0;
      }
      tbody tr:hover {
        background: #f6f9ef;
        cursor: default;
      }
      td.num,
      th.num {
        text-align: right;
        font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
      }
      .table-wrap {
        overflow: auto;
        border: 1px solid var(--line);
        border-radius: 14px;
        background: #fff;
      }
      .table-wrap::-webkit-scrollbar {
        height: 9px;
        width: 9px;
      }
      .table-wrap::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
        background: #d2d8c7;
        border-radius: 9px;
        border: 2px solid #fff;
      }
      .table-wrap::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
        background: #bdc6ac;
      }
      .table-wrap::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
        background: transparent;
      }

      /* ===== Badges ===== */
      .badge {
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 5px;
        font-size: 11.5px;
        font-weight: 700;
        padding: 3px 9px;
        border-radius: 999px;
        white-space: nowrap;
      }
      .badge .bdot {
        width: 7px;
        height: 7px;
        border-radius: 50%;
        background: currentColor;
        flex: 0 0 auto;
      }
      .b-alto {
        background: var(--nobg);
        color: var(--no);
      }
      .b-medio {
        background: var(--warnbg);
        color: var(--warn);
      }
      .b-baixo {
        background: var(--okbg);
        color: var(--ok);
      }
      .b-incompleto {
        background: #eef1f6;
        color: #5a6678;
      }
      .b-grupo {
        background: var(--chip);
        color: #44506a;
      }
      .pill {
        display: inline-block;
        font-size: 11px;
        font-weight: 700;
        padding: 2px 8px;
        border-radius: 6px;
        background: var(--chip);
        color: #44506a;
      }
      .danger-cell {
        color: var(--no);
        font-weight: 700;
      }
      .ok-cell {
        color: var(--ok);
        font-weight: 700;
      }

      /* ===== Cobertura (insight) ===== */
      .cov-card {
        background: var(--card);
        border: 1px solid var(--line);
        border-radius: 14px;
        box-shadow: var(--shadow);
        padding: 14px 16px;
        margin-bottom: 16px;
      }
      .cov-card:empty {
        display: none;
      }
      .cov-head {
        display: flex;
        justify-content: space-between;
        align-items: center;
        font-weight: 700;
        font-size: 14px;
        margin-bottom: 10px;
      }
      .cov-bar {
        display: flex;
        height: 14px;
        border-radius: 8px;
        overflow: hidden;
        background: var(--chip);
      }
      .cov-bar > span {
        display: block;
        height: 100%;
      }
      .cov-bar .cov-est {
        background: var(--ok);
      }
      .cov-bar .cov-ped {
        background: var(--warn);
      }
      .cov-bar .cov-buy {
        background: var(--no);
      }
      .cov-legend {
        display: flex;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        gap: 16px;
        margin-top: 10px;
        font-size: 12.5px;
        color: var(--txt);
      }
      .cov-legend .dot {
        display: inline-block;
        width: 10px;
        height: 10px;
        border-radius: 3px;
        margin-right: 5px;
        vertical-align: -1px;
      }
      .cov-legend .dot.est {
        background: var(--ok);
      }
      .cov-legend .dot.ped {
        background: var(--warn);
      }
      .cov-legend .dot.buy {
        background: var(--no);
      }

      .empty {
        padding: 40px;
        text-align: center;
        color: var(--muted);
      }
      .empty .es-ico {
        width: 46px;
        height: 46px;
        margin: 0 auto 12px;
        border-radius: 12px;
        background: var(--chip);
        color: var(--muted);
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
      }
      .empty .es-ico svg {
        width: 24px;
        height: 24px;
      }
      .empty .es-title {
        font-weight: 700;
        color: var(--txt);
        font-size: 14px;
        margin-bottom: 3px;
      }
      .spinner {
        width: 18px;
        height: 18px;
        border: 2px solid var(--pri-soft);
        border-top-color: var(--pri);
        border-radius: 50%;
        animation: spin 0.7s linear infinite;
        display: inline-block;
      }
      @keyframes spin {
        to {
          transform: rotate(360deg);
        }
      }

      .pager {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 10px;
        justify-content: flex-end;
        margin-top: 14px;
      }

      /* ===== Modal ===== */
      #modalRoot:empty {
        display: none;
      }
      .modal-bg {
        position: fixed;
        inset: 0;
        background: rgba(12, 24, 48, 0.45);
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        z-index: 60;
        padding: 20px;
      }
      .modal {
        background: #fff;
        border-radius: 16px;
        width: 620px;
        max-width: 96vw;
        max-height: 90vh;
        overflow: auto;
        box-shadow: 0 24px 70px rgba(8, 30, 70, 0.4);
      }
      .modal.confirm {
        width: 420px;
      }
      .modal .mhead {
        padding: 16px 20px;
        border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
      }
      .modal .mhead h3 {
        margin: 0;
        font-size: 16px;
      }
      .modal .close {
        margin-left: auto;
        background: none;
        color: var(--muted);
        padding: 4px 8px;
        font-size: 18px;
      }
      .modal .body {
        padding: 20px;
      }
      .grid2 {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
        gap: 12px;
      }
      .grid2 > div label {
        margin-bottom: 2px;
      }
      .grid2 > div > div {
        font-size: 14px;
      }
      .modal .actions {
        display: flex;
        gap: 10px;
        justify-content: flex-end;
        margin-top: 18px;
      }
      .confirm-ico {
        width: 48px;
        height: 48px;
        border-radius: 50%;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        font-size: 24px;
        margin: 0 auto 12px;
      }
      .confirm-ico.danger {
        background: var(--nobg);
        color: var(--no);
      }
      .confirm-ico.ask {
        background: var(--pri-soft);
        color: var(--pri2);
      }
      .confirm-msg {
        text-align: center;
        font-size: 14.5px;
        margin-bottom: 8px;
      }
      .confirm-actions {

      /* ---- markdown renderer (respostas do assistente) ---- */
      function mdInline(s) {
        let h = esc(s);
        h = h.replace(/`([^`]+)`/g, (m, c) => `<code>${c}</code>`);
        h = h.replace(
          /\[([^\]]+)\]\((https?:\/\/[^\s)]+|mailto:[^\s)]+)\)/g,
          (m, t, u) =>
            `<a href="${u}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">${t}</a>`,
        );
        h = h
          .replace(/\*\*([^*]+)\*\*/g, "<strong>$1</strong>")
          .replace(/__([^_]+)__/g, "<strong>$1</strong>");
        h = h.replace(/(^|[^*])\*([^*\n]+)\*(?!\*)/g, "$1<em>$2</em>");
        return h;
      }
      function mdRender(src) {
        if (src == null) return "";
        const lines = String(src).replace(/\r\n/g, "\n").split("\n");
        let html = "",
          i = 0,
          inList = false;
        const closeList = () => {
          if (inList) {
            html += "</ul>";
            inList = false;
          }
        };
        while (i < lines.length) {
          let line = lines[i];
          if (
            /^\s*\|.*\|\s*$/.test(line) &&
            i + 1 < lines.length &&
            /^\s*\|[\s:|-]+\|\s*$/.test(lines[i + 1])
          ) {
            closeList();
            const header = line
              .trim()
              .replace(/^\||\|$/g, "")
              .split("|")
              .map((c) => c.trim());
            i += 2;
            let rows = [];
            while (i < lines.length && /^\s*\|.*\|\s*$/.test(lines[i])) {
              rows.push(
                lines[i]
                  .trim()
                  .replace(/^\||\|$/g, "")
                  .split("|")
                  .map((c) => c.trim()),
              );
              i++;
            }
            html +=
              '<div class="tbl-scroll"><table><thead><tr>' +
              header.map((h) => `<th>${mdInline(h)}</th>`).join("") +
              "</tr></thead><tbody>" +
              rows
                .map(
                  (r) =>
                    "<tr>" +
                    r.map((c) => `<td>${mdInline(c)}</td>`).join("") +
                    "</tr>",
                )
                .join("") +
              "</tbody></table></div>";
            continue;
          }
          if (/^\s*[-*]\s+/.test(line)) {
            if (!inList) {
              html += "<ul>";
              inList = true;
            }
            html += `<li>${mdInline(line.replace(/^\s*[-*]\s+/, ""))}</li>`;
            i++;
            continue;
          }
          closeList();
          if (/^\s*#{1,3}\s+/.test(line)) {
            const lvl = line.match(/^\s*(#{1,3})/)[1].length;
            html += `<h${lvl + 2}>${mdInline(line.replace(/^\s*#{1,3}\s+/, ""))}</h${lvl + 2}>`;
            i++;
            continue;
          }
          if (line.trim() === "") {
            html += "";
            i++;
            continue;
          }
          html += `<p>${mdInline(line)}</p>`;
          i++;
        }
        closeList();
        return html;
      }

      function donutChart(segments, opts) {
        opts = opts || {};
        const segs = segments.filter((s) => Number(s.value) > 0);
        const total = segs.reduce((a, s) => a + Number(s.value), 0) || 1;
        const R = 56,
          CIRC = 2 * Math.PI * R;
        let acc = 0;
        let arcs;
        if (!segs.length) {
          arcs = `<circle cx="70" cy="70" r="${R}" fill="none" stroke="var(--chip)" stroke-width="20"/>`;
        } else {
          arcs = segs
            .map((s) => {
              const frac = Number(s.value) / total;
              const dash = frac * CIRC;
              const c = `<circle cx="70" cy="70" r="${R}" fill="none" stroke="${s.color}" stroke-width="20" stroke-dasharray="${dash.toFixed(2)} ${(CIRC - dash).toFixed(2)}" stroke-dashoffset="${(-acc * CIRC).toFixed(2)}" transform="rotate(-90 70 70)" stroke-linecap="butt"/>`;
              acc += frac;
              return c;
            })
            .join("");
        }
        const center = opts.center != null ? opts.center : total;
        return `<svg viewBox="0 0 140 140" class="donut">${arcs}<text x="70" y="68" class="dn-num">${esc(String(center))}</text><text x="70" y="86" class="dn-lbl">${esc(opts.label || "")}</text></svg>`;

      function ragSourceBadge(d) {
        const hasDrive =
          (d.url && /drive\.google\.com/i.test(d.url)) || d.source === "drive";
        const txt = hasDrive
          ? "Google Drive"
          : d.source === "chat"
            ? "Chat"
            : "Upload direto";
        const bg = hasDrive
          ? "#6d28d9"
          : d.source === "chat"
            ? "#0e7490"
            : "var(--pri)";
        return `<span style="background:${bg};color:#fff;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:10px;font-size:11px;font-weight:600">${txt}</span>`;
      }
      function extractDocs(parsed) {
        const looksLikeDoc = (o) =>
          o &&
          typeof o === "object" &&
          !Array.isArray(o) &&
          ("id" in o || "title" in o || "file_id" in o);
        const find = (v, depth = 0) => {
          if (depth > 6 || v == null) return null;
          if (Array.isArray(v)) {
            if (v.length === 0) return v;
            if (v.every(looksLikeDoc)) return v;
            for (const item of v) {
              const f = find(item, depth + 1);
              if (f) return f;
            }
            return null;
          }
          if (typeof v === "object") {
            for (const key of [
              "docs",
              "data",
              "json",
              "body",
              "result",
              "items",
            ]) {
              if (key in v) {
                const f = find(v[key], depth + 1);
                if (f) return f;
              }
            }
            for (const key of Object.keys(v)) {
              const f = find(v[key], depth + 1);
              if (f) return f;
            }
          }
          return null;
        };
        return find(parsed) || [];
      }

          `<div class="empty">Olá! Sou o copiloto de PCP. Pergunte o que pode ser montado, o que falta numa OP ou quais compras estão atrasadas.</div>`;
        renderSuggest();
      }
      $("#chatFab").addEventListener("click", () => {
        $("#chatPanel").classList.add("open");
        $("#chatFab").style.display = "none";
        if (!$("#msgs").innerHTML.trim()) renderChatEmpty();
        if (window.lucide) lucide.createIcons();
      });
      $("#closeChat").addEventListener("click", () => {
        $("#chatPanel").classList.remove("open", "max");
        $("#chatFab").style.display = "flex";
      });
      $("#maxChat").addEventListener("click", () => {
        $("#chatPanel").classList.toggle("max");
        $("#msgs").scrollTop = $("#msgs").scrollHeight;
      });
      function newSessionId() {
        return (
          "sess-" + Date.now() + "-" + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)
        );
      }
      $("#newChat").addEventListener("click", () => {
        curSession = newSessionId();
        renderChatEmpty();
        $("#chatSessions").classList.add("hidden");
      });
      $("#histBtn").addEventListener("click", () => {
        const s = $("#chatSessions");
        s.classList.toggle("hidden");
        if (!s.classList.contains("hidden")) loadSessions();
      });
      async function loadSessions() {
        try {
          const r = await fetch(
            `${CONFIG.N8N_BASE}/bralyx-sessions?userId=${encodeURIComponent(ME.id)}`,
          );
          const arr = await safeJson(r);
          const list = Array.isArray(arr) ? arr : [];
          $("#chatSessions").innerHTML = list.length
            ? list
                .map(
                  (s) =>
                    `<div class="s" data-id="${esc(s.session_id || s.sessionId)}"><i data-lucide="message-square"></i><span class="grow">${esc(stripCtx(s.titulo || s.title || "").slice(0, 40) || "Conversa")}</span></div>`,
                )
                .join("")
            : `<div class="empty" style="padding:16px">Sem conversas anteriores.</div>`;
          if (window.lucide) lucide.createIcons();
          $("#chatSessions")
            .querySelectorAll(".s")
            .forEach((d) =>
              d.addEventListener("click", () => {
                openSession(d.dataset.id);
                $("#chatSessions").classList.add("hidden");
              }),
            );
        } catch (e) {
          /* noop */
        }
      }
      async function openSession(id) {
        curSession = id;
        try {
          const r = await fetch(
            `${CONFIG.N8N_BASE}/bralyx-history?sessionId=${encodeURIComponent(id)}&userId=${encodeURIComponent(ME.id)}`,
          );
          const arr = await safeJson(r);
          const msgs = (Array.isArray(arr) ? arr : [])
            .map((m) => m.message)
            .filter(Boolean);
          $("#msgs").innerHTML =
            msgs
              .map((m) => {
                const type = m.type === "human" ? "u" : "a";
                const cc = stripCtx(m.content);
                return `<div class="msg ${type}">${type === "a" ? mdRender(cc) : esc(cc)}</div>`;
              })
              .join("") || '<div class="empty">Conversa vazia.</div>';
          $("#msgs").scrollTop = $("#msgs").scrollHeight;
        } catch (e) {
          /* noop */
        }
      }
      async function sendChat() {
        const t = $("#chatInput").value.trim();
        if (!t) return;
        if (!curSession) curSession = newSessionId();
        if ($("#msgs").querySelector(".empty")) $("#msgs").innerHTML = "";
        $("#suggest").innerHTML = "";
        $("#msgs").appendChild(el("div", "msg u", esc(t)));
        $("#chatInput").value = "";
        $("#chatInput").style.height = "44px";
        $("#msgs").scrollTop = $("#msgs").scrollHeight;
        const thinking = el("div", "msg a", "…");
        $("#msgs").appendChild(thinking);
        $("#msgs").scrollTop = $("#msgs").scrollHeight;
        const ctx = pageContextLabel();
        try {
          const r = await fetch(`${CONFIG.N8N_BASE}/bralyx-AgentRag`, {
            method: "POST",
            headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
            body: JSON.stringify({
              sessionId: curSession,
              userId: ME.id,
              userName: ME.full_name,
              message: `[PÁGINA: ${ctx}] ${t}`,
              pageContext: ctx,
            }),
          });
          const j = await safeJson(r);
          thinking.innerHTML = mdRender(
            (j && (j.output || j.text)) || "(sem resposta)",
          );
          refreshCurrentView();
        } catch (e) {
          thinking.innerHTML = "Erro: " + esc(e.message);
        }
        $("#msgs").scrollTop = $("#msgs").scrollHeight;
      }
      function autoGrowChatInput() {
        const i = $("#chatInput");
        i.style.height = "auto";
        i.style.height = Math.min(i.scrollHeight, 140) + "px";
      }
      $("#sendChat").addEventListener("click", sendChat);
      $("#chatInput").addEventListener("input", autoGrowChatInput);
      $("#chatInput").addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
        if (e.key === "Enter" && !e.shiftKey) {
          e.preventDefault();
          sendChat();
        }
      });
      $("#chatAttach").addEventListener("click", () => {
        if (!curSession) curSession = newSessionId();
        $("#chatFileInput").click();
      });
      $("#chatFileInput").addEventListener("change", async (e) => {
        const files = Array.from(e.target.files);
        e.target.value = "";
        if (!files.length) return;
        if (!curSession) curSession = newSessionId();
        if ($("#msgs").querySelector(".empty")) $("#msgs").innerHTML = "";
        for (const f of files) {
          const note = el("div", "msg u", `📎 ${esc(f.name)}`);
          $("#msgs").appendChild(note);
          try {
            const fd = new FormData();
            fd.append("data", f, f.name);
            fd.append("userId", ME.id);
            fd.append("sessionId", curSession);
            const r = await fetch(`${CONFIG.N8N_BASE}/bralyx-rag-upload`, {
              method: "POST",
              body: fd,
            });
            if (!r.ok) throw new Error("HTTP " + r.status);
            $("#msgs").appendChild(
              el(
                "div",
                "msg a",
                `Arquivo “${esc(f.name)}” anexado a esta conversa. Pode perguntar sobre ele.`,
              ),
            );
          } catch (err) {
            $("#msgs").appendChild(
              el(
                "div",
                "msg a",
                "Falha ao anexar “" + esc(f.name) + "”: " + esc(err.message),
              ),
            );
          }
          $("#msgs").scrollTop = $("#msgs").scrollHeight;
        }
      });
    </script>
  </body>
</html>
